answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a polynomial identity commitment over their Semaphore leaf and RLN rate-limit nullifier. A valid message proves eligibility without exposing identity; duplicate use of the same secret-derived nullifier yields two polynomial points, enabling Shamir reconstruction of the private key. The protocol then instantly slashes collateral, making zephyr, ferrous, or hollow Sybil identities economically untenable.
